Title: Governed Trial Cycle Closure and Fresh-Cycle Selection
Kind: TRIAL-cycle governance correction (temporary DevBridge scaffolding for Nexus Phase 1/2; nothing migrates into Nexus)
Summary: The FINAL HARDENED LANE C TRIAL PART 1 exposed a GOVERNANCE-STATE GAP (not an M03 defect): M03 auto-selected WI-07-0.2.4 (CHG-20260830-017) again with M03=PASS, Verdict=CLEAR, even though its trial lifecycle ended at CLAUDE_REVIEW_PASSED_TRIAL / TRIAL_CYCLE_SAFE_STOP / TRIAL_ONLY_UNMERGED and M10 was correctly NOT run. DB-M12.4 adds an explicit governed TRIAL-CYCLE closure capability: TRIAL_CYCLE_SAFE_STOP -> CLOSE_TRIAL_CYCLE -> TRIAL_CYCLE_CLOSED. It closes temporary trial execution state, releases the trial reservation, preserves all trial evidence, and permits a later fresh proving cycle. It does NOT run M10, does NOT mark the Nexus work item genuinely complete, does NOT create a PR, does NOT merge, and does NOT modify roadmap structure. A fresh proving cycle is selected by M03's proving-history exclusion: the used/closed node is never re-selected in TRIAL mode while genuine governed current work is surfaced (S9). REAL_NEXUS_DEVELOPMENT mode prohibits CLOSE_TRIAL_CYCLE explicitly (blocked before any script runs). All writes land on fixture copies under logs\selftest\db124; the authoritative workbook, the Nexus repo, and the live trial evidence are asserted byte-identical (I1-I3). The governed LIVE closure of WI-07-0.2.4 (CHG-20260830-017) was EXECUTED on 2026-08-31T15:24:45Z: reservation row 80 set Closed-terminal (never Completed), roadmap node remains Planned, exactly one Activity Log row appended (row 57), TRIAL_ONLY_UNMERGED evidence preserved, protected roadmap fingerprint unchanged, PR/merge/M10 all NOT performed, lifecycle refreshed to TRIAL_CYCLE_CLOSED / nextAllowedAction START_NEXT_CYCLE, idempotent re-close verified. Three post-closure hardening fixes were added and regression-proven: (1) the real-lifecycle completion.json guard is scoped by the record's OWN changeId -- a prior cycle's genuine record (WI-07-0.2.3/CHG-20260830-016) no longer blocks closure, while an unprovable or same-change record still blocks with STOP_TRIAL_HAS_REAL_LIFECYCLE (S12/S13); (2) evidence fidelity -- trial-closure.json preWriteBackupSha256 now records the pre-closure backup's ACTUAL SHA256 with a separate preWriteBackupPath field instead of the path (S1 SHA assertion); (3) the DB-M12.4 and DB-M12.2 fixture suites now source fixture workbooks from a PRISTINE F520060C baseline (the live closure's own pre-write backup) and assert the live workbook matches its GOVERNED RECORDED state (post-closure SHA), so they remain green after a live closure.

RootCause.Observation: M03 selected WI-07-0.2.4 again (CHG-20260830-017) with M03=PASS, Verdict=CLEAR despite the trial lifecycle ending at TRIAL_CYCLE_SAFE_STOP and M10 correctly NOT run.
RootCause.WhyGap: The trial lifecycle had no explicit terminal closure capability: safe-stop was a stop, but nothing released the trial reservation or recorded a governed closed-cycle history that fresh M03 selection could consult.
RootCause.Correction: Explicit TRIAL_CYCLE_SAFE_STOP -> CLOSE_TRIAL_CYCLE -> TRIAL_CYCLE_CLOSED transition plus a trial-proving-history exclusion consulted by M03 in TRIAL mode.
